vacor_10.m: Preposterous, isn't it? I was so close to having the power!

vacor_11.m: Oh, the power I could have had. My dear rift spell.

vacor_12.m: Anyway, I was just about to finish the last piece of my rift spell when the bandits came and robbed me.

vacor_13.m: The bandits took my notes for the spell and took off before I could call the guards.

vacor_14.m: After years of work, I can't seem to remember the last parts of the spell.

vacor_15.m: Do you think you could help me locate it? Then I could have the power at last!

vacor_16.m: You will of course be suitably rewarded for your part in me getting this power.
r: Very well. I will help you.
No thanks, this seems like something that I would rather not get involved with.

vacor_17.m: I knew I couldn't trust... Wait, what? You actually said yes? Hah, well then.

vacor_18.m: OK, find the four pieces of my rift spell that the bandits took, and bring the pieces to me.

vacor_19.m: There were four bandits, and they all headed south of Fallhaven after I was attacked.

vacor_2.m: What are you, some kind of adventurer? Hmm. Maybe you can be of use to me.

vacor_20.m: You should search the southern parts of Fallhaven for the four bandits.

vacor_21.m: Please hurry! I am so eager to open up the rift ... erm, I mean finish the spell. Nothing odd with that right?

vacor_3.m: Are you willing to help me?
r: Sure, what do you need help with?
No, why should I help you?

vacor_4.m: A while ago, I was working on a rift spell that I had read about.

vacor_40.m: Oh, you found all four pieces? Hurry, give them to me.

vacor_41.m: Yes, these are the pieces that the bandits took.

vacor_42.m: Now I should be able to finish the rift spell and open up the Shadow rift ... erm I mean open up new possibilities. Yes, that's what I meant.

vacor_43.m: The only obstacle between me and continuing my rift spell research is that stupid Unzel fellow.

vacor_44.m: Unzel was my apprentice a while ago. But he started to annoy me with his questions and talk about morality.

vacor_45.m: He said that my spell making was disrupting the will of the Shadow.

vacor_46.m: Bah, the Shadow. What has it ever done for ME?!

vacor_47.m: I shall one day cast my rift spell and we will be rid of the Shadow.

vacor_48.m: Anyway. I have a feeling that Unzel sent those bandits after me, and if I don't stop him he will probably send more.

vacor_49.m: I need you to find Unzel and kill him for me. He can probably be found somewhere southwest of Fallhaven.

vacor_5.m: The spell is supposed to, shall we say, open up new possibilities.

vacor_50.m: Bring me his signet ring as proof when you have killed him.

vacor_51.m: Now hurry, I cannot wait much longer. The power shall be MINE!

vacor_6.m: Erm, yes, the rift spell will open things up alright. Ahem.

vacor_60.m: Ha ha, Unzel is dead! That pathetic creature is gone!

vacor_61.m: I can see the blood on your boots. I even got you to kill his minions beforehand.

vacor_62.m: This is a great day indeed. I will soon have the power!

vacor_63.m: Here, have these coins for your help.

vacor_64.m: Now leave me, I have work to do before I can cast the rift spell.

vacor_7.m: So there I was working hard on getting the last pieces together for it.

vacor_70.m: What? He told you his story? You actually believed it?

vacor_71.m: I will give you one more chance. Either kill Unzel for me, and I will reward you handsomely, or you will have to fight me.
r: OK, I'll think about it once more.

vacor_72.m: Bah, lowly creature. I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Now you will die along with your precious Shadow.

vacor_8.m: Then, all of a sudden, a gang of thugs came around and started bullying me.

vacor_9.m: They said they were Messengers of the Shadow, and insisted that I should cease my spell making.

vacor_bah.m: Bah, lowly creature. I knew I shouldn't have asked you. Now leave me.

vacor_msg1.m: What's that in your hands?! ... I recognize that seal!
r: You should recognize it, I found this on one of Unzel's associates in Remgard.

vacor_msg_10.m: [The map shows a location to the northwest of the former prison of Flagstone]

vacor_msg_12.m: [Vacor opens the sealed message and starts reading]

vacor_msg_14.m: Thanks kid, you have helped me more than you can possibly understand.

vacor_msg_15.m: HA HA HA!!! THE POWER WILL SOON BE MINE!
r: Excellent! The Shadow must be stopped!
I just wanted a reward... Weirdo.

vacor_msg_16.m: Thanks for giving me that message, but now please leave me. I have more important things to do than to talk to you.

vacor_msg_3.m: Good, maybe now I can work on my Rift Spell in peace...

vacor_msg_5.m: I must know what they are planning!

vacor_msg_6.m: I have a cache of potions hidden, far to the southwest.
r: Excellent, I could always use more supplies.

vacor_msg_7.m: Good. Now give me the message.

vacor_msg_8.m: Here, take this map as compensation for your troubles.

vacor_msg_9.m: It will lead you far to the southwest, to one of my secret retreats ... where a cache of potions is hidden.

vacor_msg_a1.m: Surely, he didn't just give it to you!
r: He was asking too many questions. He needed to be silenced.
Kaverin is dead. His blood is still on my boots.

vacor_msg_b1.m: How did you get your hands on that document?!
r: A man in Remgard, by the name of Kaverin, was asking about Unzel...
Kaverin is dead. His blood is still on my boots.

vacor_return1.m: Hello again. How is the search for my missing pieces of the rift spell going?
r: I have found all the pieces.
What was I supposed to do again?
Could you tell me the whole story again?
Could you tell me the story again?

vacor_return2_2.m: Have you killed Unzel for me yet? Bring me his signet ring when you have killed him.
r: I have dealt with him. Here is his ring.
I listened to Unzel's story and have decided to side with him. The Shadow must be preserved.

vacor_return_complete.m: Hello again, my assassin friend. I will soon have my rift spell ready.

vacor.10:
A mage called Vacor in southwest Fallhaven has been trying to cast a rift spell.
There was something not right about him, he seemed very obsessed with his spell. Something about him gaining a power from it.
vacor.20: Vacor wants me to bring him the four pieces of the rift spell that he claims was stolen from him. The four bandits should be somewhere south of Fallhaven.
vacor.30: I have brought the four pieces of the rift spell to Vacor.
vacor.40: Vacor tells me about his former apprentice Unzel, who had started to question Vacor. Vacor now wants me to kill Unzel. I should be able to find him to the southwest outside of Fallhaven. I should bring his signet ring to Vacor once I have killed him.
vacor.50: Unzel gives me a choice to side with either Vacor or him.
vacor.51: I have chosen to side with Unzel. I should go to southwest Fallhaven to talk to Vacor about Unzel and the Shadow.
vacor.53: I started a fight with Unzel. I should bring his ring to Vacor once he is dead.
vacor.54: I started a fight with Vacor. I should bring his ring to Unzel once he is dead.
vacor.60: I have killed Unzel and told Vacor about the deed.
vacor.61: I have killed Vacor and told Unzel about the deed.

kaverin.10: I met Kaverin in Remgard, that apparently is an old acquaintance of Unzel, who lives outside of Fallhaven.
kaverin.20: Kaverin wants me to deliver a message to Unzel.
kaverin.21: I have declined to help Kaverin.
kaverin.22: I have agreed to deliver the message.
kaverin.25: Kaverin has given me the message that he wants me to deliver to Unzel.
kaverin.30: I have delivered the message to Unzel. I should return to Kaverin in Remgard.
kaverin.40: Kaverin thanked me for delivering the message to Unzel.
kaverin.45: In return, Kaverin gave me an old map that he had acquired. Apparently, it leads to Vacor's old hideout.
kaverin.60: Kaverin was furious over the fact that I killed Unzel, and that I helped Vacor. He started attacking me. I should return to Vacor once Kaverin is dead.
kaverin.70: Kaverin was carrying a sealed message. Vacor immediately recognized the seal, and seemed very interested in it.
kaverin.75: I have given Vacor the message that Kaverin was carrying. In return, Vacor gave me an old map, leading to his old hideout.
kaverin.90: I should try to find Vacor's old hideout, on the road to the west of the former prison of Flagstone, southwest of Fallhaven.
kaverin.100: I have found Vacor's old hideout.
